18.7 Entire Agreement; Amendments. This Agreement (including the Exhibits attached hereto), together with the pharmacovigilance agreement specified in Section 4.11(b), the Quality Agreement, and the Supply Agreement (in each case, when executed) constitute the entire agreement between the Parties relating to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior and contemporaneous agreements, representations and/or understandings, including the Confidentiality Agreement between the Parties dated August 26, 2016.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "recruit" and "induce" return no restrictive covenant on personnel; the covenants provisions and the full General Provisions block (Sections 18.1-18.14) contain no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation, and the integration clause confirms no prior agreement (including the 2016 Confidentiality Agreement) survives to import one. Ono is therefore bound by no non-solicit, which is the playbook's preferred position, so no redline is warranted. If a non-solicit is later proposed, it should be mutual, limited to personnel directly involved, capped at 12 months from the end of involvement, and carve out general advertising and unsolicited approaches.
